title: Explosion effects, hit feel, and UI update complete!
author: Latter_Associate4015
selftext: My game is called 'Gunners'! I released it as a mobile game two weeks ago, and I just pushed out a bunch of updates. Enhancing the hit feel and visual explosion effects definitely makes the gameplay a lot more fun.
